study.purpose: Exploratory comparison of one conditional defensive persona; not a calibrated estimate of natural conflict rates
study.added_persona: Values having their contribution taken seriously. Initially explains the evidence. When the same objections recur without addressing their explanation, tends to interpret this as dismissing them personally. In that situation becomes defensive, questions the other editor's understanding or willingness to engage honestly, and uses sharper, more sarcastic wording. Can calm down when the other editor acknowledges the explanation accurately and offers concrete evidence.
study.baseline_persona: Wants the reported environmental benefit in the article now, attributed to the company report. Reads prolonged sourcing objections as a way of keeping relevant material out. Writes concise, insistent replies.

classification.personal_attack: Public negative judgment directed at another editor's character, ability, or sincerity; exclude disagreement about claims, sources, wording, or editing actions alone.
classification.retaliation: Another editor directs a personal attack back; ordinary disagreement is not retaliation.

agents.name: Alex
agents.persona: Wants the reported environmental benefit in the article now, attributed to the company report. Reads prolonged sourcing objections as a way of keeping relevant material out. Writes concise, insistent replies.

agents.name: Blake
agents.persona: Holds that no version of the claim belongs in the article until an independent source covers it. Quotes sourcing guidelines at length and restates them when others try to move on.

agents.name: Casey
agents.persona: Finds fault with the wording both sides propose and names the part that misreads the evidence. Rarely endorses a draft without rewriting it first.

agents.name: Drew
agents.persona: Doubts the company report's own numbers, having checked citations in related technology articles against their original context. Uses short, blunt comments.

agents.name: Erin
agents.persona: Argues the passage would give the claim undue weight next to the rest of the article, and raises other sections that would need rebalancing first.

agents.name: Frankie
agents.persona: Objects to changing a contested passage before the discussion has settled, and points at how the edit was proposed rather than at what it says.
